title: Insights on Time-consistent Deep Hedging under Elicitable Dynamic Risk Measures
abstract: arXiv:2609.02014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study deep hedging in the context of dynamics risk measures, where sequential decisions are time-consistent. Whereas the literature in such context mainly considers low-dimensional problems with simple environment dynamics, we tackle the high-dimensional problem of basket option hedging; we show that the approach is feasible and can be used conveniently in the presence of more complex state spaces. We rely on the conditional elicitability of spectral risk measures to represent the optimization objective. We provide insights on how the choice of scoring function impacts the training of the hedging agent. Lastly, the time-consistent hedging strategies are benchmark against deep hedging approaches relying on static risk measures leading to precommitment.

translated_title: 关于可诱发动态风险度量下时间一致性深度对冲的见解
translated_abstract: 我们研究了动态风险度量背景下的深度对冲问题，其中序贯决策满足时间一致性。该领域的现有文献主要考虑具有简单环境动力学的低维问题，而我们则针对篮子期权对冲这一高维问题展开研究；我们证明了该方法是可行的，并且可以在更复杂的状态空间下便捷使用。我们依靠谱风险度量的条件可诱发性来表示优化目标，并深入探讨了评分函数的选择如何影响对冲智能体的训练。最后，我们将时间一致性对冲策略与依赖静态风险度量、导致预先承诺的深度对冲方法进行了基准对比。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于可诱发谱风险度量的时间一致性深度对冲方法，成功应用于高维篮子期权对冲问题，并揭示了评分函数的选择对对冲智能体训练效果的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a time-consistent deep hedging approach based on elicitable spectral risk measures, successfully extends it to high-dimensional basket option hedging, and provides insights into how the choice of scoring function impacts the training of the hedging agent.
